senses.gloss:
पुल् {c1c} {c6c} P., {c10c} U. (पोलति, पुलति,
पोलयति-ते)
1 To draw or pull out.
--2
To be great.
--3 To be lofty.
--4 To
be collected together, be gathered.

पूल् {c1c} P., {c10c} U. (पूलति, पूलयति-ते)
To heap up, collect, gather.

पुल a. Great, large, wide,
extensive.
--लः Horripilation.
पुला The soft palate, uvula.

1 Erection or bristling of
the hairs of the body, a thrill (of
joy or fear), horripilation; चारु
चुचुंब नितंबवती दयितं पुलकैरनुकूले Gīt. 1;
मृगमदतिलकं लिखति सपुलकं मृगमिव
रजनीकरे 7; Amaru. 57, 77.
--2 A kind
of stone or gem.
--3 A flaw or
defect in a gem.
--4 A kind of mineral.
--5 A ball of food with which
elephants are fed (गजान्नपिंड).
--6
Yellow orpiment.
--7 A wine-glass.
--8 A
species of mustard.
--Comp.
--अंगः
the noose of Varuṇa.
--आलयः an
epithet of Kubera.
--उद्गमः erection
of the hairs of the body,
horripilation.

पुलाकः --कं
1 Empty, bad or
shrivelled grain; Ms. 10. 125.
--2
A lump of boiled rice.
--3
Abridgment, compendium.
--4 Brevity,
conciseness.
--5 Rice-water.
--6
Despatch, celerity.
--7 Smallness.
पूलः, पूलकः A bundle, pack.
पूलाकः = पुलाक q. v.

पुलकयति Den. P. To have the
hairs of the body erect, thrill (with
joy &c.).

पुलकित a. Having the hairs of the
body erect, thrilled with joy; hence,
rejoiced, enraptured.

पुलकिन् a. (नी f.) Having the
hairs of the body erect &c. --m. A
species of Kadamba tree.
पुलाकिन् m. A tree.

पुलकीकृत a. Thrilled with joy,
rejoiced.

पुलाकः --कं
1 Empty, bad or
shrivelled grain; Ms. 10. 125.
--2
A lump of boiled rice.
--3
Abridgment, compendium.
--4 Brevity,
conciseness.
--5 Rice-water.
--6
Despatch, celerity.
--7 Smallness.
पुलायितं A horse's gallop.

पुलिनः --नं [पुल्-इनन् किच्च;
Uṇ. 2. 53]
1 A sand-bank, sandy
beach; रमते यमुनापुलिनवने विजयी
मुरारिरधुना Gīt. 7; R. 14. 52;
sometimes used in pl.; कालिंद्याः पुलिनेषु
केलिकुपितामुत्सृज्य रासे रसं Ve. 1. 2.
[]
--2 A small island left in the bank
of a river by the passing off of the
water, an islet.
--3 The bank of
a river.

पुलिनः --नं [पुल्-इनन् किच्च;
Uṇ. 2. 53]
1 A sand-bank, sandy
beach; रमते यमुनापुलिनवने विजयी
मुरारिरधुना Gīt. 7; R. 14. 52;
sometimes used in pl.; कालिंद्याः पुलिनेषु
केलिकुपितामुत्सृज्य रासे रसं Ve. 1. 2.
[]
--2 A small island left in the bank
of a river by the passing off of the
water, an islet.
--3 The bank of
a river.
पुलिनवती A river.

पुलिंदः, पुलिंदकः
1 N. of a
barbarous tribe (usually in pl.).
--2
A man of this tribe, a savage,
barbarian, mountaineer; R. 16. 19, 32.

पुलिंदः, पुलिंदकः
1 N. of a
barbarous tribe (usually in pl.).
--2
A man of this tribe, a savage,
barbarian, mountaineer; R. 16. 19, 32.
पुलिरिकः A snake.

पुलोमन् m. N. of a demon, the
father-in-law of Indra.
--Comp.
--अरिः, --जित्, --भिद्, --द्विष् m. epithets of
Indra.
--जा, --पुत्री Śacī, daughter
of Puloman and wife of Indra.

पुलोमा N. of the wife of Bhṛgu
and mother of Cyavana.

पूपला(ली), पूपालिका, पूपाली,
पूलिका, पूपिका A sort of sweet cake.
पूलिका A kind of cake.
पूलः, पूलकः A bundle, pack.
पूल्यं An empty grain of corn.
